options.name: api_path
options.description: Base NITRO API path. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: basicauth
options.description: Enable or disable basic authentication for Nitro API.

options.name: cliloglevel
options.description: Audit log level, which specifies the types of events to log for cli executed commands. Available values function as follows: * C(EMERGENCY) - Events that indicate an immediate crisis on the server. * C(ALERT) - Events that might require action. * C(CRITICAL) - Events that indicate an imminent server crisis. * C(ERROR) - Events that indicate some type of error. * C(WARNING) - Events that require action in the near future. * C(NOTICE) - Events that the administrator should know about. * C(INFORMAT

options.name: daystoexpire
options.description: Password expiry days for all the system users. The daystoexpire value ranges from 30 to 255.

options.name: doppler
options.description: Enable or disable Doppler

options.name: fipsusermode
options.description: Use this option to set the FIPS mode for key user-land processes. When enabled, these user-land processes will operate in FIPS mode. In this mode, these processes will use FIPS 140-2 certified crypto algorithms. With a FIPS license, it is enabled by default and cannot be disabled. Without a FIPS license, it is disabled by default, wherein these user-land processes will not operate in FIPS mode.

options.name: forcepasswordchange
options.description: Enable or disable force password change for nsroot user

options.name: googleanalytics
options.description: Enable or disable Google analytics

options.name: localauth
options.description: When enabled, local users can access Citrix ADC even when external authentication is configured. When disabled, local users are not allowed to access the Citrix ADC, Local users can access the Citrix ADC only when the configured external authentication servers are unavailable. This parameter is not applicable to SSH Key-based authentication

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_id
options.description: The ID of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_ip
options.description: The IP of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_name
options.description: The name of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_password
options.description: The password of the managed NetScaler instance. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call In Settings > Administration > System Configurations > Basic Settings, if you select Prompt Credentials for Instance Login, ensure to configure username and password of a managed instance.

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_username
options.description: The username of the managed NetScaler instance. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call In Settings > Administration > System Configurations > Basic Settings, if you select Prompt Credentials for Instance Login, ensure to configure username and password of a managed instance.

options.name: maxsessionperuser
options.description: Maximum number of client connection allowed per user.The maxsessionperuser value ranges from 1 to 40

options.name: minpasswordlen
options.description: Minimum length of system user password. When strong password is enabled default minimum length is 8. User entered value can be greater than or equal to 8. Default mininum value is 1 when strong password is disabled. Maximum value is 127 in both cases.

options.name: natpcbforceflushlimit
options.description: Flush the system if the number of Network Address Translation Protocol Control Blocks (NATPCBs) exceeds this value.

options.name: natpcbrstontimeout
options.description: Send a reset signal to client and server connections when their NATPCBs time out. Avoids the buildup of idle TCP connections on both the sides.

options.name: netscaler_console_as_proxy_server
options.description: The IP address of the NetScaler ADC appliance acting as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: nitro_auth_token
options.description: The authentication token provided by a login operation.

options.name: nitro_pass
options.description: The password with which to authenticate to the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: nitro_protocol
options.description: Which protocol to use when accessing the nitro API objects.

options.name: nitro_user
options.description: The username with which to authenticate to the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: nsip
options.description: The ip address of the NetScaler ADC appliance where the nitro API calls will be made. The port can be specified with the colon (:). E.g. 192.168.1.1:555.

options.name: passwordhistorycontrol
options.description: Enables or disable password expiry feature for system users. If the feature is C(ENABLED), by default the last 6 passwords of users will be maintained and will not be allowed to reuse same. When the feature is enabled the daystoexpire, warnpriorndays and pwdhistoryCount will be set with default values. The values can only be set in system for system parameter. It cannot be unset. It is possible to set and unset the values for daytoexpire and warnpriorndays in system groups. Default values if fea

options.name: promptstring
options.description: String to display at the command-line prompt. Can consist of letters, numbers, hyphen (-), period (.), hash (#), space ( ), at (@), equal (=), colon (:), underscore (_), and the following variables: * %u - Will be replaced by the user name. * %h - Will be replaced by the hostname of the Citrix ADC. * %t - Will be replaced by the current time in 12-hour format. * %T - Will be replaced by the current time in 24-hour format. * %d - Will be replaced by the current date. * %s - Will be replaced by th

options.name: pwdhistorycount
options.description: Number of passwords to be maintained as history for system users. The pwdhistorycount value ranges from 1 to 10.

options.name: rbaonresponse
options.description: Enable or disable Role-Based Authentication (RBA) on responses.

options.name: reauthonauthparamchange
options.description: Enable or disable External user reauthentication when authentication parameter changes

options.name: remove_non_updatable_params
options.description: When given yes, the module will remove any parameters that are not updatable in the resource. If no, the module will return error if any non-updatable parameters are provided.

options.name: removesensitivefiles
options.description: Use this option to remove the sensitive files from the system like authorise keys, public keys etc. The commands which will remove sensitive files when this system paramter is enabled are rm cluster instance, rm cluster node, rm ha node, clear config full, join cluster and add cluster instance.

options.name: restrictedtimeout
options.description: Enable/Disable the restricted timeout behaviour. When enabled, timeout cannot be configured beyond admin configured timeout  and also it will have the [minimum - maximum] range check. When disabled, timeout will have the old behaviour. By default the value is disabled

options.name: save_config
options.description: If C(true) the module will save the configuration on the NetScaler ADC node if it makes any changes. The module will not save the configuration on the NetScaler ADC node if it made no changes.

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the resource being configured by the module on the NetScaler ADC node. When C(present), the resource will be added/updated configured according to the module's parameters. When C(unset), the resource will be unset on the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: strongpassword
options.description: After enabling strong password (C(enableall) / C(enablelocal) - not included in exclude list), all the passwords / sensitive information must have - Atleast 1 Lower case character, Atleast 1 Upper case character, Atleast 1 numeric character, Atleast 1 special character ( ~, `, !, @, #, $, %, ^, &, *, -, _, =, +, {, }, [, ], |, \, :, <, >, /, ., ,, " "). Exclude list in case of C(enablelocal) is - NS_FIPS, NS_CRL, NS_RSAKEY, NS_PKCS12, NS_PKCS8, NS_LDAP, NS_TACACS, NS_TACACSACTION, NS_RADIUS, NS_

options.name: timeout
options.description: CLI session inactivity timeout, in seconds. If Restrictedtimeout argument is enabled, Timeout can have values in the range [300-86400] seconds. If Restrictedtimeout argument is disabled, Timeout can have values in the range [0, 10-100000000] seconds. Default value is 900 seconds.

options.name: totalauthtimeout
options.description: Total time a request can take for authentication/authorization

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(false), SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.

options.name: wafprotection
options.description: Configure WAF protection for endpoints used by NetScaler management interfaces. The available options are: * C(DEFAULT) - NetScaler decides which endpoints have WAF protection enabled. * C(GUI) - Endpoints used by the Management C(GUI) Interface are WAF protected. * C(DISABLED) - WAF protection is disabled.

options.name: warnpriorndays
options.description: Number of days before which password expiration warning would be thrown with respect to daystoexpire. The warnpriorndays value ranges from 5 to 40.
